title.zh: 开通云安全中心多账号安全管理功能
title.en: Enable the multi-account management feature of security center

descriptions.zh: 需使用资源目录的管理账号或云安全中心委派管理员账号调用该接口。
descriptions.en: Call this operation by using the management account of the resource directory or a delegated administrator account of Security Center.
